g.text: What price fits the buyer's starting finances?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e

g.text: Baseline income, cash, rates and reserve held fixed. Bars are financial-screen limits; dashed line is the observed 2023 benchmark.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: The search isolates transfer-tax, insurance-premium and insured/uninsured-rate boundaries rather than assuming one globally smooth relationship. Exact

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: whole-dollar thresholds and additional cash needed at each benchmark are in homebuying_price_limits.csv. Buyer finances and costs are assumptions.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: This is not a market-price forecast, a safe spending recommendation or lender approval. Sources: Statistics Canada, Bank of Canada, CMHC and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e
font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e
